mainEntity.name: Why does nature of legal fees matter at the fees stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because the visitor should know exactly how payment is made, how proof is sent, and when scheduling actually becomes possible. Before the next step, nature of legal fees usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
